curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives
curriculum.note: This class folder on Google Drive is empty. The objectives below are taken verbatim from the Stages 3 and 4 column of the 0838 Primary Global Perspectives Progression Grid, which is in the Primary 1 folder and covers every stage. Cambridge sets one objective for Stages 3 and 4 together, so Primary 4 works towards the same objectives as Primary 3; the challenge topics here are deliberately different so the two years do not repeat, and the expectation is that Primary 4 meets them with more independence.

objectives.title: Recognise that people think different things about an issue
Draw simple conclusions from graphical or numerical data
Talk about simple causes of personal actions and consequences on others
Suggest personal actions that could make a positive difference to an issue affecting others
Work positively with team members, contributing ideas to improve team work or the shared outcome
The team allocates given tasks to team members to achieve a shared outcome
Present information about a given issue clearly and with an appropriate structure
Listen to others in class discussions and respond with relevant ideas and questions
Discuss a source, recognising the author's ideas about an issue
Express an opinion about another person's ideas on an issue, giving reasons for own opinion
Identify strengths and limitations of personal contribution to teamwork
Identify how working together improved the shared outcome achieved
Talk about what has been learned during an activity and consider how personal ideas have changed
Identify which types of activities support learning
Construct own questions to aid understanding of an issue
Locate relevant information and answers to questions within sources provided
Conduct investigations, using interviews or questionnaires, making observations and taking appropriate measurements
Select, organise and record information from sources and findings from primary research in simple charts or diagrams
